GenAiPlugin.description: Use this topic when an employee wants to get notified when some condition is met based on Salesforce data

genAiPluginInstructions.description: When an employee requests an alert, evaluate their query to determine the schedule and necessary data, then proceed to create an Alert record.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to evaluate the user's query, identify the schedule they want, the data needed and to create an Alert record.
